name: compositor-mcp-workspace
description: Deep Model Context Protocol integration for the Compositor macOS image editor

scripts.build: npm run build -w @compositor-mcp/protocol && npm run build -w @compositor-mcp/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @compositor-mcp/protocol && npm run test -w @compositor-mcp/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @compositor-mcp/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @compositor-mcp/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run parity
